discussion: Microsoft AD DS contains a number of built-in security groups that have elevated permissions or deliberately relaxed security policies. These security groups are often required for a specific purpose; however, overuse or inappropriate use may allow malicious actors to more easily move laterally throughout a network or escalate their privileges. Privileged security groups in particular should be limited to the smallest set of possible users to limit malicious actors’ opportunities for privilege escalation.
section_path: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services security group memberships
title: When a user account is disabled, it is removed from all security group memberships.
